Delivering and withdrawing a project, held with Results publishing: the domain's list_team_projects, get_team_package, find_customer, deliver_project and withdraw_project, the resource's team, team_package, find_customer, deliver and withdraw actions and their admin policies, projects/customer.ex, project/team_member.ex, project/deliver.ex, projects/package.ex, live/team_messages_live.ex and TechtreeWeb.TeamGate; the package controller's admin branch (lines 26-29) with them. Until they come, the team delivers on techtree.sh and this site shows what it delivered, as both read the same table.
projects/manifest.ex: it checks a manifest when the team delivers; the pages and the agent's answer read the manifest stored with the project, already checked.
read.ex (TechtreeWeb.Read): the Projects pages read through RegentsWeb.Techtree.Outage.read/1, so a failed read shows its words without the last value kept.

agent_account_controller.ex's Points (account_points) and its unexpected-failure log: the site's own Points answer /api/v1/account/points, and a failure that is not an outage raises as on every page here.
projects.css's team-deliver and team-projects rules: they style the team's page, held above.

project.ex's identity, check constraint and index, and the projects migration: techtree.sh's migration made the table (platform/priv/techtree/migrations/20261114130927_add_projects.exs is its record) and this resource only reads it.

The source's :account_only pipeline, which sends cache-control private, no-store on the account pages: the pages here are in Techtree's live session under the site's browser pipeline, which is the regents chief's; the package and every agent answer send no-store themselves.
